answer: The inlet edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 29 clones produces a signature the karst analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the quartz settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
